question: Does entering while at least one other portfolio position is already active change any strategy's native stressed return per planned-risk dollar and stop-loss incidence with enough temporal breadth and magnitude to justify one later entry-preserving crowding-conditioned management experiment?

fixed_reconstruction.row_handling: Preserve every distinct full CSV row. Order within each period by parsed server_time, numeric state_sequence, fixed event precedence, source path and source line; state_sequence may repeat and is not a row key.
fixed_reconstruction.market_birth: OPEN begins an RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure or Return lifecycle and supplies birth planned_risk.
fixed_reconstruction.passive_birth: PASSIVE_FILL begins an admitted Passive lifecycle using planned_risk from its paired PASSIVE_PLACE.
fixed_reconstruction.release: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends the active lifecycle; close value_b is native stressed net USD.
fixed_reconstruction.entry_time_incumbents: Immediately before the new lifecycle birth event, count all other admitted active position lifecycles. Pending Passive orders are not positions and are excluded.
fixed_reconstruction.stressed_r: native stressed net USD divided by birth planned_risk
fixed_reconstruction.stop_loss: The lifecycle ends with EXTERNAL_CLOSE whose detail reason is DEAL_REASON_SL.
fixed_reconstruction.pooled_effect: CROWDED mean stressed_r minus SOLO mean stressed_r for one strategy.
fixed_reconstruction.period_effect: The same mean difference separately in each period.
fixed_reconstruction.pooled_stop_effect: CROWDED stop-loss rate minus SOLO stop-loss rate for one strategy.
fixed_reconstruction.period_stop_effect: The same stop-rate difference separately in each period.

fixed_integrity_gate: All input hashes remain frozen and exact duplicate full rows equal zero.
All 2,233 lifecycles and 407.0477 USD stressed net reconstruct exactly with no signal, planned-risk, fill, expiration, overlap or close fault.
Every birth observes only positions active before its ordered birth event; the new position never counts itself.
Every lifecycle has exactly one nonnegative incumbent count and one stop-loss classification.

requirements: SOLO and CROWDED each contain at least 20 pooled lifecycles.
Each group contains at least five lifecycles in at least three periods.
Absolute pooled CROWDED-minus-SOLO mean stressed_r is at least 0.10R per lifecycle.
Among periods with at least five observations in both groups, at least three period stressed-R effects share the pooled sign.
Absolute pooled CROWDED-minus-SOLO stop-loss-rate difference is at least 0.10.
The pooled stop effect is economically concordant: a negative stressed-R effect requires a positive stop effect, and a positive stressed-R effect requires a negative stop effect.
Among periods with at least five observations in both groups, at least three period stop effects share the pooled stop sign.
fixed_information_gate.selection: Select at most one passing strategy by larger absolute pooled stressed-R effect, then larger absolute pooled stop effect, then more stressed-R sign-breadth periods, then lexicographic name.
fixed_information_gate.passing_action: Retain one later Lab management experiment for the selected strategy using entry-time crowding only. It must preserve every frozen base entry, retain unchanged 4%/12% admission, and may not authorize Live.
fixed_information_gate.failure_action: Close with no crowding-conditioned candidate. Do not rescue with incumbent direction, identity, symbol, pending-order count, two-plus threshold, exact cohort shape, time slice or period exception.

descriptive_only: later incumbent or candidate P/L attribution
stop_rules: Run exactly one successful fixed aggregation; implementation-only failures before judgment may be corrected and disclosed.
Do not run MT5 or modify MQL in this unit.
Do not suppress an entry or claim a management mechanism from association alone.
Do not alter, query or restart Live.
